annotations.text:
Direction C chosen — rig column iterations.
All three share: minimal header (bpm · tuning · loop · play), units with LED status dots and collapse chevrons, '‹ hide' to reclaim sheet width, persistent-settings hint at the bottom.
They differ only in control style — pick a dial language.

C · SLIDERS (lead)
Flat sliders + toggles + segmented picking. Chugs unit shown collapsed. Most compact and closest to today's controls.
Tradeoff: least thematic flair.

C2 · ROTARY KNOBS
Amp-face rotary dials for tight/volume/grip on a brushed head unit. Most 'amp' of the three.
Tradeoff: knobs need drag interaction; values less scannable.

C3 · STOMPBOXES
Each unit a pedal: colored top stripe, LED, footswitch. Playful, very genre.
Tradeoff: heavier visually; footswitches are decorative.
Earlier directions kept for reference — A (drawer) and B (rack strip) were not chosen; C's original sketch preserved for comparison.
